failure_definition: q < 0.9 or pi1(a0) < 0.9; non-finite seeds also fail
fisher_rank_definition: numerical rank of the undamped sampled-action empirical Fisher from the batch used at the recorded optimizer update
schedule_indexing: zero-based t; updates t < switch_time use beta=0.2 and later updates use beta=0
stream_derivation: one CPU torch.Generator seeded 23 per unit; identical tensor shapes give paired base-uniform streams across switch times
